about: Twitch's Get Started with no SDK (Twitch publishes none): an app access token from the client credentials grant with the developer console's TWITCH_CLIENT_ID and TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET, validated (no login, no user id), then the channel TWITCH_CHANNEL read through Get Users (its numeric id, no email to an app token), Get Channel Information and Get Streams (offline: an empty list). The account and its application are the World's credential door's; retained-state readback reads the same user and channel with the saved token, writing nothing. Chat over IRC, the authorize page and the ingest are walked in the life, not here.
